_comment: Claude Code local-cli adapter. The harness owns the worktree, environment boundary, and role contract; this adapter only fixes the non-interactive CLI protocol.
name: claude-code

_flags_rationale.-p {{envelope_json}}: Claude Code accepts a non-interactive prompt as one argv value. sandbox-profile.sh expands the JSON without invoking a shell.
_flags_rationale.--output-format stream-json: Keeps the CLI event stream in the sandbox run log for audit and failure analysis.
_flags_rationale.--no-session-persistence: A dispatch task must not create resumable Claude sessions in a user profile.
_flags_rationale.--permission-mode acceptEdits: Allows the constrained worktree task to create its commissioned artifact. It does not bypass permissions; source return and push authority remain controlled by the framework role policy and sandbox.

_auth_note: Runtime credentials remain an explicit integration precondition. Use a scoped ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an explicitly supplied CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; the sandbox never inherits the whole real HOME.
_verified_note: Claude Code 2.1.220 interface probe on 2026-07-31 accepted the non-interactive print, stream-json, no-session-persistence, permission-mode, and tools flags before returning the expected AUTH_REQUIRED result on an unauthenticated host. The adapter transport is covered by the sandbox fixture contract; a project must still configure valid Claude credentials before dispatching work.
